title: Three applicants: parallel readers, one decision
story: Three readers work at the same time (one survives an OCR timeout), then a decision maker joins them against the job post. The top-ranked school does not rescue the applicant without SQL.
description: A hiring lead fans three résumés out to three reader agents in parallel, then a decision maker combines their summaries into yes or no for each, using only the job post's must-have requirements.
